title: Todo store and query filters
instructions:
Complete an in-memory todo store and its query module.

## Files
- `todo_store.py`: `TodoStore`.
- `todo_query.py`: `select`, operating on a `TodoStore`.

`TodoStore()` starts empty. Its methods are:
- `add(title: str, tags: Iterable[str] = ()) -> int`: strip the title;
  reject an empty title. Strip and casefold each tag; reject empty tags,
  remove duplicates, and sort tags lexicographically. Allocate integer IDs
  starting at 1; increment only on successful adds and never reuse removed
  IDs. New records have done=False. Copy caller tag data.
- `get(task_id: int) -> dict`: return exactly `id` (int), `title` (str),
  `done` (bool), and `tags` (list[str]). Missing IDs raise `KeyError`.
- `set_done(task_id: int, done: bool) -> None`: set completion; reject values
  that are not actual bools with `ValueError` before checking the ID. Missing
  IDs with valid done values raise `KeyError`.
- `remove(task_id: int) -> bool`: remove and return True, or False if absent.
- `items() -> list[dict]`: all records in increasing ID order.
All returned dictionaries and tag lists are detached copies. Invalid adds
or updates leave data and the next ID unchanged. Validation uses `ValueError`.

`select(store: TodoStore, done: bool | None = None, tag: str | None = None,
text: str = "", limit: int | None = None) -> list[dict]` combines all filters
with AND. None means no done/tag filter. A supplied tag is stripped and
casefolded and must be nonempty; match an exact normalized tag. Strip and
casefold text and match it as a substring of the casefolded title; empty
text matches all titles. Order results by incomplete first, then ID ascending
within each completion state. Apply limit after filtering and sorting; zero
returns an empty list. Reject non-bool non-None done values and negative,
boolean, or non-integer non-None limits with `ValueError`, even on an empty
store. Returned records are detached; querying never changes the store.
Other arguments have the specified types.
